meta.title: G44 V action and recoil
meta.frame: metres, +Z muzzle, +Y up, +X shooter's left; origin on the bore axis at the slide's rear face
meta.time_zero: the trigger bar releases the firing pin
meta.units: SI unless the key says otherwise (mm, deg, MPa)

nodes.firing_pin: p04_firing_pin (translate +Z by striker_fwd_mm relative to the rest pose)
nodes.slide_stop: p27_slide_stop_lever (rotate +3.7 deg about X when held open)

bore_area.source: .22 LR groove diameter 5.6 mm, less 1.5 % for the lands (SAAMI Z299.1 rimfire, nominal)

case_area.source: .22 LR case body diameter 0.225 in (SAAMI Z299.1)

m_case.source: empty .22 LR brass case, about 9 grains

m_cartridge.source: maker's weights: loaded magazine - empty magazine = 50 g for 15 rounds

chamber_vol.source: .22 LR case capacity about 0.23 cm3 gross less the seated bullet heel

bullet_travel_test.source: CCI velocities are test-barrel figures; 24 in rimfire test barrel (SAAMI Z299.1), less the case length

bullet_travel.source: maker's barrel length 102 mm less the case length

p_map.source: SAAMI maximum average pressure for .22 Long Rifle: 24,000 psi (Z299.1)

burn_exp.source: pressure exponent of the burn law

p_ign.source: pressure left by the priming compound

p_start.source: crimp and engraving of the heeled bullet

p_fric.source: bore friction as an equivalent pressure (about 50 N); a lubricated lead bullet

m_striker.source: model volume of the firing pin and spring cups x steel density (inventory.json)

striker_precock.source: model: firing pin held part-cocked with the trigger forward

striker_break.source: model kinematics: part-cock plus the trigger bar travel to the break

striker_F_fired.source: firing pin spring force with the pin forward

striker_F_cocked.source: firing pin spring force at the break; gives 0.10 J. It must stay below the recoil spring load in battery or the slide could not close

rim_crush.source: depth of the rim indent at ignition

trigger_pull.source: maker's specification table: trigger pull 26 N

m_slide.source: model volumes x nominal densities, scaled so slide + barrel + frame = the published 358 g (model/checks.json). The split is not published

m_pistol.source: maker's specification table: weight without magazine

m_magazine.source: maker's table: with empty magazine 415 g

travel.source: model: lock-open travel 42 mm measured from a photo (manual p. 21) + 3 mm

lock_open.source: slide position locked open, manual p. 21 picture 18

spring_F0.source: recoil spring load in battery. Not published

spring_F1.source: recoil spring load at full travel (about 14.6 lbf). Not published; chosen with m_slide so that standard-velocity ammunition cycles and CCI Quiet-22 does not, as the makers say

obturation.source: share of the gas force on the case head that reaches the slide; the rest is case friction on the chamber wall

strip_force.source: drag of stripping a round from the feed lips

u_eject.source: model: ejector tip 15 mm behind the breech face

u_feed.source: model: breech face passes the rim of the top round

e_rear.source: restitution, slide on the polymer frame

m_hand.source: effective mass of hands and forearms moving with the pistol

bore_height.source: bore axis above the wrist pivot (socket_hand_right is 52 mm below the bore, the wrist lower still)

eject_speed_ratio.source: case speed over slide speed at the ejector

eject_azimuth_deg.source: from +Z toward -X (to the right, slightly rearward)

two_hand.note: both hands, arms extended; all four numbers inferred, not measured

cci_quiet_22.label: CCI Quiet-22 40 gr LRN (part 960)

published.maker_note: CCI: may be used in semi-automatic firearms, however manual cycling of the action may be required

cci_quiet_22.outcome: cycles, but will not lock open on the last round

load_note: charge mass and peak pressure are guesses (not published); the burn coefficient and loss factor are calibrated so the 24 in test barrel gives the published velocity at that peak pressure

firing.note: striker_mm: rearward position of the firing pin from its fired position; it is released at the break and flies forward

mechanics.notes: travel numbers come from model/inventory.json so the clips and this simulation agree

trigger.note: force at the trigger against rotation; only the 26 N break is published, the take-up shape is inferred

cci_quiet_22.outcome: short stroke: ejects but does not pick up the next round

momentum.note: breech impulse = bullet momentum + bore friction impulse + gas momentum; a conservation check on the integration
breech impulse = bullet momentum + bore friction impulse + gas momentum; a conservation check on the integration

slide.outcome: cycles, but will not lock open on the last round

cci_standard_velocity.statement: manual p. 12: designed to work with quality SAAMI / CIP .22 l.r. ammunition

cci_quiet_22.statement: manual p. 12: some .22 l.r. loads may not produce sufficient energy to fully cycle the slide; CCI: manual cycling of the action may be required
cci_quiet_22.model: cycles, but will not lock open on the last round (34.0 of 45 mm)

function_against_makers_statements.note: a qualitative check: the recoil spring loads and the slide mass are not published and were chosen inside the window where these statements hold (see sensitivity)

brass.note: nominal ejection for the reference load, in the gun frame; scatter is Gaussian; speeds per load scale with events.eject_slide_speed

parity.note: sample() evaluated by sim.py at random times; test_action.js must reproduce these with g44v-action.js
